title: Staging serves no robots.txt (404): staging must serve Disallow: / ; production robots should be defined

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: `packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs` ROUTE_FILE regex omitted `robots`, so `routes.manifest.json` had no `app/robots.ts` and `papyrus-app sync` wrote no `/robots.txt` shim; consumers 404 in staging and production. Fix: PR #185 (squash a02f90e), released 1.0.0-next.39. `lib/robots-policy.ts`: staging/dev Disallow all, production Allow /, newsroom rootRoute hosts Disallow all always; site-owned app/robots.ts wins. Tests: test:robots-policy (in test:ci:ts), test:package-contents manifest assertion; verified in scratch p.apyr.us consumer. Sites must bump @anthusai/papyrus to 1.0.0-next.39 and run sync.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Pin bumps to @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.39 done and verified (robots.txt: production Allow: /, staging Disallow: /). p.apyr.us PR #9 merged as 5c5fb9e (main job 12 and staging job 3 SUCCEED). Threat-Intelligence PR #19 merged as 5847655 (main job 14 and staging job 4 SUCCEED).

right_now_summary: The fix is released, and staging and production now serve the correct robots.txt rules.
